points: fb: fits how you work, since you post in the right repo's session. Two gaps: a task can live only in the handoff, outside git, and [closed] is self-attested. Fix: home tasks in the repo, and check each closed id against its home.

/board was a proof of concept built from three plain elements (Box, Text, Button). The desktop app also offers Svg, Markdown and a custom Client region. Add done, now and next per session, read from each handoff.

Map: merged Oct 20 in #525 (the map skill moves here), which replaced #455, #456 and #457. Every new file needs a map line; generating the structure from code and making the sync checks advisory are still worth weighing.
Health view: the map (structure), /board (live work), compliance-check (rules), plus the size numbers and the sweep's keep reasons.

Roadmap per repo: debts, feedback items, repo plans, session plans, PRs. Read each from its one home, store no copy, show freshness, and mark anything unreadable as unknown. Session-only items need homes in git first; live session state stays in /board.
summary: Your own tools, and how they fit together.
